title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Palladium on 1971-08-06
lineage: D>CD: Fostex D5->SB Live Digi I/O->Cool Edit Pro (by Ben Kasper)
source: Sony ECM-22P mics > Sony 770 reel deck, 1/4 track 7.5 ips. 40-50 feet back, dead center

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience FLAC capture of a high‑energy 1971 show with a smoking Hard to Handle and wild Other One transitions.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers crystal‑clear 1971 sound that many reviewers call “absolutely sick,” preserving the band’s volcanic energy. Highlights include an off‑the‑charts Hard to Handle, seamless Truckin’ → St Stephen segues, and a mind‑bending Other One/Me & My Uncle jam, all driven by a lively crowd at the tiny Hollywood Palladium.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently glowing 4‑5 star reviews praising both performance and sound quality; strong weighting toward show excellence with excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: FLAC from an audience taping praised as crystal clear for a 1971 source; no major drop‑outs reported, listeners note the recording sounds “sick” and captures the band’s dynamics.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, high‑energy flow with remarkable segues (Truckin' → St Stephen, The Other One → Me & My Uncle → The Other One) and an unexpected Weather Report Suite Prelude jam.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar work praised overall; a minor tuning issue noted on Brokedown but strong tone on Hard to Handle.
